title: Ram Teri Ganga Maili
desc: Ganga sets out for Calcutta with her son after her husband leaves them. Hoping for a better life, she is betrayed along the way and ends up trapped in a brothel.

title: Iqbal
desc: Iqbal, a hearing- and speech-impaired boy, dreams of playing for India. When his condition blocks his selection, he turns to a retired coach to train him for his dream.

title: Kisi Ka Bhai Kisi Ki Jaan
desc: Bhaijaan, the eldest brother, stays unmarried to keep peace in the family. But things get complicated when his younger brothers secretly try to make him fall in love.

title: Karz
desc: Monty learns the shocking truth of his past life-betrayed and killed by his greedy wife, leaving his family homeless. With his lover's support, he vows to set things right.

title: Khalnayak
desc: Inspector Ram arrests notorious criminal Ballu, but when Ballu escapes and ruins Ram's reputation, his fiancee Ganga sets a trap-only to face trouble when Ballu unexpectedly falls for her.

title: O' Romeo
desc: A skilled enforcer helps a woman seek justice for her husband's death. As danger grows and enemies close in, their bond deepens amid betrayal and revenge.

title: Chaalbaaz
desc: Separated twins Anju and Manju grow up differently and accidentally swap lives. Shy Anju enters a rustic world, while bold Manju bravely takes revenge on their evil uncle.

title: Pure Bollywood
desc: Bollywood songs - catchy, emotional, and upbeat - dominate the charts. From heartbreak to celebration, these tracks capture every mood, making people dance, cry, and sing along everywhere.

title: Saajan Ki Bahon Mein
desc: Sagar is ready to marry Kavita when he meets Sapna, his former love who is set to marry his childhood friend and life-changing facts surface.

title: International Khiladi
desc: Reporter Payal is sent to interview criminal Devraj. During the interview, they fall in love, but this upsets Devraj's guardian and creates trouble for them.

title: Tapasya
desc: Indu, eldest daughter of a sick man, falls for her father's doctor. But her lover's mother demands she abandon her family and place her in-laws above all else.

title: Dream Girl
desc: Karamveer lands a call-center job thanks to his knack for mimicking a woman's voice. Fame follows, but trouble brews as obsessed clients push him into dangerous territory.

title: Ek Aur Ek Gyarah
desc: Tara and Sitara, thieves, hide in Major Ram Singh's house. When Cobra kidnaps their mother, they must deceive Ram to save her and free Panther.

title: Uri - The Surgical Strike
desc: After a deadly terrorist attack in Uri, Major Vihaan Singh Shergill leads a covert operation to eliminate the terrorists responsible, executing a high-risk mission deep across the border.

title: Henna
desc: An Indian man falls into a river, losing his memory and drifting into Pakistan. Villagers care for him, but tragedy strikes when his forgotten past painfully resurfaces.

title: Aatma - Feel It Around You
desc: After losing custody of his daughter to Maya, Abhay dies in an accident. Soon, his restless spirit returns, haunting their peaceful lives and unsettling their newfound happiness.
